notes: «أبي ره» is the compiler's father, named only by relation: a relation link.
«عن أخيه علي بن مهزيار»: the brother is named, so the link is the name alone (rule 7).
The Imam «أبي عبد الله» is written inside the chain after «عن», so he stays narrator; the saying («قال: ما من شيء ...») is his words.
